''See also: [[Wind aura Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Wind [[aura]] is a natural energy aspect that manifests as a vivid green presence in Spiritual sight{{!}}spiritual sight, though it can also appear to the naked eye as green-tinted gusts or swirling air. It is a fundamental element used by [[wind]] artists to manipulate the atmosphere, allowing them to fly on currents of air, create protective barriers, or generate violent cyclones and emerald-colored storms. Beyond simple movement, advanced practitioners use [[wind]] [[aura]] for sophisticated techniques, such as forming razor-sharp cyclones to attack a [[spirit]] or creating high-pressure walls of air. In combat and utility, [[wind]] [[aura]] can be commanded to act as a physical force, such as hardening the air to block impacts, cushioning falls, or even creating [[chains]] of green energy to immobilize opponents. It can also be utilized for subtle tasks, including blocking out sound, clearing smoke and heat, or levitating objects. While it is a natural force, its behavior can be influenced by [[madra]] and [[soulfire]]; for instance, an artist might use their power to command the air to obey them or weave it together with other energies like fire or [[destruction]]. In certain environments, the [[wind]] [[aura]] can be exceptionally strong, posing a danger to those who lack sufficient [[madra]] to resist its pressure.}}
